featured.title: Singapore's Indian-Origin Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon to Retire in February 2027
featured.excerpt: Menon, Singapore's first locally born Chief Justice, will step down after more than 14 years on the bench. Justice Sushil Nair has been appointed as the country's fifth Chief Justice.
featured.image_caption: Chief Justice Sundaresh Menon in 2019. Singapore's PMO announced on July 17 that Menon will retire on February 26, 2027, after more than 14 years as Chief Justice.
featured.nri_angle: The succession from Menon to Nair means Singapore will have two consecutive Indian-origin Chief Justices, reflecting the community's prominence in Southeast Asian legal circles.
featured.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asian communities face elevated diabetes and metabolic syndrome rates, making GLP-1 drug findings on cancer risk especially relevant for India and the diaspora.

lifestyle-health.title: India Approves Wegovy for Fatty Liver Disease in New Milestone for GLP-1 Drugs

lifestyle-health.image_caption: A medical professional prepares a syringe for injection. Wegovy is administered as a once-weekly subcutaneous injection using a prefilled pen device.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians are disproportionately susceptible to metabolic liver disease, and the approval gives family in India access to a treatment previously limited to Western markets.
